# v3.18-dev

## Fixed

- **Compliance Planning no longer forgets your plan when you go Back.** Clicking a
  person in **Who to certify** or **Renewals at risk** to open their record, then
  pressing Back, returned you to an empty planner — the scope, the programs and
  targets you had picked, and the renewal window were all reset, so the plan had
  to be rebuilt from scratch every time you looked someone up.

  The page now keeps your selection in its address, the same way the report pages
  already do, and restores it on the way back. Nothing to turn on: open a record,
  press Back, and the plan is exactly as you left it.

## Also in this release

- A planning view is now **bookmarkable and shareable** as a consequence of the
  above — copy the page link and it reopens with the same scope, programs,
  targets and renewal window.
